packaging_note: The full V2 research workspace is intentionally kept outside the formal submission because the submission contract only permits approved artifact directories. This compact record preserves the evidence chain used by formal geometry, metrics and figures.

population.caveat: Modelled population estimate, not census population.

osm_context.caveat: Context/proxy evidence only; not a statutory survey or complete official service registry.

robust_opportunity_v02.green_layer: historical OSM public park/garden proxy baseline; superseded for final sensitivity and design re-audit by v0.4 Sentinel vegetation deficit

service_node_audit.replacement_method: 12 unordered objective-specific candidates -> 8 spatial clusters at 120 m -> 55 feasible four-site combinations -> maximin multi-objective consensus
service_node_audit.post_sentinel_v04_status: formal 8+4 consensus geometry retained after full v0.4 tie-aware Sentinel multi-objective re-optimization

v04_consensus_reoptimization.method: rerun three objective-specific four-node searches on opportunity v0.4; spatially deduplicate their 12 selections; exhaust all feasible four-site combinations; maximize the minimum normalized population/gap1/gap2/opportunity-population criterion
v04_consensus_reoptimization.interpretation: The v0.4 re-optimized set raises opportunity-population mean by 0.009139 but reduces population coverage by 0.005026 and gap1 coverage by 0.004411, with gap2 unchanged; therefore the current formal four-point consensus remains the better balanced scheme.

pilot_corridor.design_role: research lead candidate; not an approved engineering alignment
pilot_corridor.post_sentinel_status: CORRIDOR-04 remains rank-1 lead after explicit Sentinel green-deficit dimension

unresolved_evidence: Formal redlines, tenure, utilities, rail safety, accessibility/fire constraints and field survey can trigger node or corridor re-selection.
Official-facility spatial validation is intentionally partial because district directories do not cover all central/university hospitals and unmatched records are not geocoded by guesswork.

sentinel2_green.method: five unique-date low-cloud Sentinel-2 L2A composite via Planetary Computer Data API tiles; B08/B04/B11/SCL; SCL-filtered median; 100m reporting grid
sentinel2_green.caveat: Spectral vegetation/built proxies, not statutory green-space or cadastral land-use area.

robust_opportunity_v04.green_formula: mean(inverse tie-aware percentile vegetation_fraction, inverse tie-aware percentile dense_vegetation_fraction)
robust_opportunity_v04.status: final sensitivity model used for post-Sentinel re-audit

official_facility_validation.method: official identity/address + OSM coordinate conservative name reconciliation
official_facility_validation.caveat: Official identities/addresses are reconciled to OSM coordinates conservatively; unmatched official facilities are not treated as absent and this layer does not replace the full OSM service layer.
